result.explanation: Track each byte as either unknown or a known numeric value. Puts are transactional: validate bounds and all known overlaps before writing. Reads report maximal unknown runs; clears erase the selected range.
result.mapping: The buffer positions are the target state, known count is derived from them, and each event maps directly to one state transition and output status. Comparator hysteresis is not applicable.
result.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated legal JSON contract and use the specified event shapes, safe integers, and byte ranges.
result.holds: function(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var o=output[i];if(!o||!('status'in o)||!('data'in o)||!('missing'in o)||!('known'in o)||!Array.isArray(o.missing)||typeof o.known!=='number')return false;if((o.status==='stored'||o.status==='cleared')&&o.data!==null)return false;if(o.status==='invalid'&&(o.data!==null||o.missing.length))return false;if(o.status==='complete'&&o.data===null)return false;if(o.status==='incomplete'&&o.data!==null)return false}return true}
